verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs say it keeps data in sync across client apps through realtime listeners, and Realtime Database is named as a product. A community report describes syncing tile positions to multiple clients at once, which supports state broadcast through persisted data. The evidence never documents presence tracking (connection status or disconnect handling) or a true ephemeral, non-persisted broadcast channel. missing for 10: documented presence/online-status tracking, disconnect-cleanup mechanism, ephemeral (non-persisted) broadcast primitive, in-depth first-party docs for this pattern.
